facts: D1 analytics can inspect query volume, query latency and storage across all and/or each database in an account.
Cloudflare dashboard D1 charts are sourced from the GraphQL Analytics API.
D1 GraphQL datasets include d1AnalyticsAdaptiveGroups, d1StorageAdaptiveGroups and d1QueriesAdaptiveGroups.
D1 exported metric field names include rowsRead and rowsWritten.
D1 GraphQL datasets require an accountTag filter using the Cloudflare Account ID.
GraphQL API supports introspection; Settings can be used to discover per-dataset limits/availability.
D1 analytics metrics are retained for 31 days.
D1 billing analytics track rows read, rows written and total storage across all databases in an account.
The Cloudflare Billing > Billable Usage surface exposes total account D1 usage on daily or month-to-date windows.

currentProjectState.note: The known 78,368 subset is not a complete account total. Do not attribute the remaining usage to System1 or another database without account analytics evidence.

dimensions: databaseId when per-database attribution is needed
discoveryBeforeAssumption: Use GraphQL introspection and/or account Settings node to verify the token can see the D1 dataset and the exact sum field shape.
Do not hard-code undocumented field nesting if introspection contradicts documentation examples.

authorizationBoundary.behaviorIfAnalyticsAllowed: Use account-wide daily rowsWritten/rowsRead as the primary budget observation, plus conservative reservation for in-flight work.
authorizationBoundary.behaviorIfAnalyticsDeniedOrUnavailable: Set accountUsageState=UNKNOWN_HEADROOM and fail/defer discretionary high-write writers. Protected bounded operational writers may proceed only within explicitly reserved conservative policy; never infer unused headroom from System2-local logs.
authorizationBoundary.reason: The correction must not require a new secret or permission merely to remain safe.

budgetModelRefinement.prohibitedInference: 100000 - known System2 rowsWritten is NOT exact remaining account quota when account-wide analytics is unavailable.

acceptanceImplications: REMEDIATION must provide an account-usage probe abstraction with explicit OBSERVED_ACCOUNT_USAGE versus UNKNOWN_HEADROOM states.
Analytics-token denial must be a normal fail-safe state, not a workflow crash that tempts permission expansion.
Recent A1 warmup push mutation remains prohibited regardless of analytics availability.
No quota gate may infer System1's exact write contribution unless account analytics resolves database attribution.
No paid Cloudflare plan, secret, or permission change is authorized by this evidence.
